requirements.rule: Arts. 21 and 64: the elements an employer owes when it does not pay EBILAV (25 EUR) or the health fund (15 EUR) are paid 'per 14 mensilità', while this CCNL has 13 monthly payments: the engine pays them on the 13 the contract has, one month less a year.
requirements.remediation: Pay the two fund substitutes on a fourteenth payment, or source that they follow the 13 monthly payments of the CCNL.

requirements.rule: LEVEL F: the 2023 table pays level F until July 2026; the 2026 renewal prints no transition for F workers. The caller must restate the worker's level from July 2026. The caller must state F for the first 12 months of effective D duties, E for months 13-24 and D thereafter; progression is not automatic.
requirements.remediation: Obtain a source for the classification of existing F workers at renewal; the published table gives no transition.

requirements.rule: ORDINARY HOURS (Art. 143): the premiums of 40% on ordinary Sunday and holiday work by day and 50% on holiday work by night are modelled (supplement_bands SF_*); not modelled: the 50% of ordinary Sunday work by night of a worker whose rest day is another day, and the indennità sesto giorno of 10%.
requirements.remediation: Model the Sunday night premium and the sixth-day allowance of art. 143.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid as a private one (art. 5 names the "Stato, enti pubblici e datori privati").
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.
